title: sonchus bulbosus subsp. microcephalus
intro: Sonchus bulbosus subsp. microcephalus, commonly known as Small-headed Sow Thistle, is a plant species in the dandelion-like genus Sonchus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, fever, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus bulbosus subsp. microcephalus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
